topic: Gobekli Tepe — temples older than agriculture

beats.narration: These stone circles were built before farming was widespread.

beats.narration: Gobekli Tepe in modern Turkey dates to roughly 11,000 years ago — older than Stonehenge by millennia.

beats.narration: Hunter-gatherers organized large-scale construction long before cities or writing.

beats.narration: It forced historians to rethink which came first: complex society, or farming.
